# Game Library. ## Control your game library, all games cataloger by platform. Control your game library, all games cataloger by platform, know when you started a game, how long you are playing, set priorities, wish lists, and you can include more features you need! No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for Game Library. Wafaa.io — Turn scattered DMs into contracts you can control and prove. Turn scattered DMs into contracts you can control and prove. As a huge fan of games myself, I must say that Julio has created the perfect template! With his template, tracking game progress and sorting them by platforms becomes a breeze. Great job, Julio, and good luck! Congratulations on you launch Julio, this looks great, I love playing games and tracking what I play! Your game library seems to be an awesome tool to manage the time spent on games! This is great for those who've got a lot of games to handle with and don't know how to deal with them all!
